test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements about title block is/are true?

Statement 1: The title block is situated in the bottom right-hand corner of the drawing sheet.

Statement 2: The contents of the title block are standardised and cannot be modified to suit individual company needs.

options.text: Statement 1 is true, but statement 2 is false
Statement 1 is false, but statement 2 is true

solution:
The correct answer is __Statement 1 is true, but statement 2 is false__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Statement 1:__ The title block is typically located in the bottom right-hand corner of the drawing sheet. This placement is standard practice in technical drawings to ensure clarity and accessibility.
 
• __Statement 2:__ The contents of the title block, while generally following certain conventions, can be modified to suit the specific needs of individual companies or projects. It is not strictly standardized.
 
• Title blocks often include important information such as the project title, drawing number, scale, date, and name of the drafter or company.
 
• The flexibility in title block customization ensures that unique requirements of industries or organizations can be met effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Technical Drawings:**

 
 
• Technical drawings are precise representations used in engineering, architecture, and manufacturing.
 
• They include standardized symbols, dimensions, and annotations to convey design and production details.
 
 
 
• **Standards in Drafting:**
 
 
• International and national standards such as ISO and ANSI provide guidelines for technical drawings.
 
• These standards ensure consistency and interoperability across industries and regions.
